stories.title: About 400 French schools closed as student protests turn violent
stories.summary: Riot police clashed with high-school students across France and unions called for a teachers' strike as nearly 400 schools shut amid violent protests over school conditions that have left more than 200 people wounded. President Macron's government is struggling to contain the unrest in the EU's third-largest economy.

stories.title: Intensified Russian strikes are tearing Kyiv apart, warns mayor
stories.summary: Kyiv's mayor says intensifying Russian drone and missile strikes are "tearing the city apart," hours after the Pivdennyi (Southern) bridge was hit for the fourth time in two days, halting metro and auto traffic across it. The strikes have also knocked out data centres and internet in the capital.

stories.title: US to send third aircraft carrier towards Iran
stories.summary: The U.S. is sending a third aircraft carrier toward Iran as its Middle East deployment grows to roughly 50,000 troops, a US official said, keeping military options open as the war enters its eighth month. A new AP-NORC poll found nearly 70% of Americans say the war has not been worth fighting.

stories.title: Ethiopia, Eritrea break ties: Does the conflict risk becoming regional war?
stories.summary: Eritrea cut diplomatic ties with Ethiopia after Addis Ababa closed its Asmara embassy and expelled 10 diplomats, and analysts warn fighting in northern Ethiopia could spill into a wider regional conflict involving Sudan. An explosion reported early Thursday at Ethiopia's defence ministry added to the tensions.

stories.title: Apple says it's tightening macOS 'Full Disk Access' controls due to new risks from AI agents
stories.summary: Apple says it is tightening macOS 'Full Disk Access' controls, citing new risks from AI agents that raise the danger of granting such broad file access. The change is meant to limit how much sensitive data agent tools can reach on a user's machine.

stories.title: Medical records giant Epic pauses product development to fix security bugs that risk patients' data
stories.summary: Epic, maker of the widely used MyChart software that holds over 320 million patient records, has paused most product development to fix security flaws that could let outsiders read patient data. The bugs were surfaced after a deployment of Anthropic's cybersecurity AI model.

stories.title: Rivian issues R2 recall for poorly tightened battery packs
stories.summary: Rivian recalled its R2 SUV after finding fasteners on the high-voltage battery pack may be under-torqued, which can cause a loss of power while driving; only about 14 vehicles may be affected. It's the second recall for the R2 since deliveries began this year.

stories.title: Browns 27-24 Steelers recap: Szmyt's 56-yard field goal wins it
stories.summary: Andre Szmyt hit a career-long 56-yard field goal with 10 seconds left as the Browns beat Pittsburgh 27-24 to improve to 3-1 and take first place in the AFC North. Deshaun Watson threw for 268 yards, including the drive that set up the winning kick.

stories.title: Sonny Styles named NFC Defensive Player of the Week
stories.summary: Former Ohio State safety Sonny Styles — now with the Eagles — was named NFC Defensive Player of the Week after a standout Week 3 performance in the NFL. The award caps a strong early stretch for the Buckeyes alum at the pro level.

stories.title: Mercedes and Aston Martin go head-to-head in charity football match
stories.summary: Mercedes and Aston Martin met in a charity football match, with drivers and team staff facing off off the track ahead of the Malaysian Grand Prix weekend. The teams shared the results as a light-hearted warm-up to Sepang.

stories.title: Verstappen leads F1's return to Sepang in Bahrain GP practice
stories.summary: Formula 1 returned to Malaysia's Sepang circuit for the first time since 2017 to stage the 2026 Bahrain Grand Prix, and Max Verstappen led opening practice, beating George Russell by 0.383s. Teams used the session to gather data in hot, humid conditions.

stories.title: Escape from Tarkov speeds up skill progression and adds referral system
stories.summary: Battlestate Games accelerated character skill progression by up to 60% across all game modes and introduced an in-game referral program that pairs veteran 'Operators' with newcomer 'Candidates.' Both earn rewards — Operators gain Tarkovcoins and Bitcoins, while pairs get bonus raid XP.

stories.title: Gahanna residents to vote on 10 charter amendments in November election
stories.summary: Gahanna voters will see 10 proposed municipal charter amendments, appearing as Issues 18 through 27, on the November ballot. The measures would alter mayoral primary rules, council redistricting standards, department structure and other governance provisions.
